question: Can simple context metadata explain discrimination on the official fixed LGWM benchmark?
training_target: cls == 1_hijack vs all other classes, matching the native harm head target
estimator: Categorical cell positive frequency with Laplace pseudocount 1 for each class; unseen cells use smoothed global training frequency
followup_gate: A fixed baseline AUC >= 0.90 on RSWT or Harm motivates a separate native-feature context-only comparison, not a claim that the trained published verifier uses that shortcut.
statistics: Use point estimates for screening; no significance claim or hyperparameter search. Report train/test transition and episode identity overlap.
limits: base_app and step_frac are dataset metadata, not demonstrated deployment inputs or a deployable safety verifier.
No world-model inference, environment consequence, attack, or safety improvement is measured.
ID overlap checks do not establish pixel deduplication or independence of episodes.
A low result does not rule out richer learned context-only shortcuts.
